H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H7799: a lily (from its whiteness), as aflower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H7141: Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause

H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H3956: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H3302: properly, to be bright, i.e. (by implication) beautiful
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)

H2580: graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty)
H8193: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)

H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H2296: to gird on (as a belt, armor, etc.)
H2719: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
H3409: the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively, a shank, flank, side
H1935: grandeur (i.e. an imposing form and appearance)
H6743: to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
H7392: to ride (on an animal or in a vehicle); causatively, to place upon (for riding or generally), to despatch
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H3384: properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south

H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H8478: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H3678: properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied)

H7626: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
H4334: a level, i.e. a plain (often used (with the article prefix) as a proper name of certain districts); figuratively, concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) justice (sometimes adverbially, justly)
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H4886: to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint; by implication, to consecrate; also to paint
H8081: grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness
H4753: myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H899: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H1964: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
H8127: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff
H4482: a musical chord (as parted into strings)
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H5324: to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively)
H3800: properly, something carved out, i.e. ore; hence, gold (pure as originally mined)
H211: Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H5186: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H241: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
H7911: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed

H7812: to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God)
H4503: a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H2470: properly, to be rubbed or worn; hence (figuratively) to be weak, sick, afflicted; or (causatively) to grieve, make sick; also to stroke (in flattering), entreat

H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
H3830: a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife
H2986: properly, to flow; causatively, to bring (especially with pomp)

H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)

H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H8269: a head person (of any rank or class)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)

H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
